reasoning:
18.1（APP1）規定按下 All Presets 按鈕開啟 All Presets Pop-up，且該彈窗含四個元素：每頁最多 3 個 preset bank、Presets Shown 指示器、播放中 metadata、關閉的 X。037 拆成五個 leaf，各驗一件事。

PU0997 的處置（A-015）：本條末尾引用 (See Pop up List: PU0997)，而該 PU 不存在於 Dec 15 2023 版 Pop Up List。但與 COM-051 不同——那條的需求全文就是「See Pop Up List: PU0996」，內容 100% 委託出去故 BLOCKED；本條的內容自足，五個 leaf 各自對應條文明載的元素，PU 引用只是補充彈窗規格層級的細節（字串、逾時），而沒有任何 leaf 要求驗證那些細節。因此本 parent 正常產生 TC，不標 BLOCKED；PU0997 缺失的實際影響僅限於：彈窗的 popup-list 層級規格（如逾時行為）目前無來源可驗，且無 leaf 要求。

容器錨定（A-021）：ch18 對同一個彈窗有兩個名稱——APP1 稱 All Presets Pop up，APP2／APP10~APP13／APP17／APP18 稱 Presets Pop Up，page 30 的截圖標題亦為 Presets Pop Up。本批依 037 的 leaf 用語使用 All Presets Pop-up，不自創第三種名稱，並以 assumption marker 聲明「兩者為同一容器」這個讀法。marker 拆成兩個作用域：容器命名這一則涵蓋全部五筆；另一則單獨圈出 070-03——APP1 把 Presets Shown 指示器列為本容器的元素，但 page 30 的截圖顯示該指示器在 Edit Presets Pop Up 上，若 RD-1 採信截圖，070-03 要驗的東西在本容器裡根本不存在，這不是命名問題而是該筆 TC 的存亡問題，故必須能被單獨檢索到，而非只撈到 parent 級的籠統標記。每一行 ER 都指名容器，與 Playing Tab 的 Mixed Presets Bank（ch17）、Browse Tab 內的 Browse Presets List（ch16）、以及 Edit Presets Pop-up（APP12 開啟）明確區隔。

070-03 的字串刻意逐字用本容器自己的版本：APP3.1 規定此處顯示 "Presets Shown"，而 Browse Presets List 的同一個指示器依 PRE2.3.5 顯示 "Number of Presets Shown"（RAD-060）。兩者差兩個字，跨容器複製即為現成的假通過，故 ER 明確要求為前者且明確排除後者。

070-02 的 up to 3 是每頁上限：只驗「顯示 3 個 bank」不足以證明上限被強制，故前置條件要求設定超過 3 個 bank，ER 判定每頁顯示數不超過 3 且其餘 bank 落在後續頁面。070-04 的 metadata 以「與 Playing Tab 上顯示的相同」判定，取得可比對基準而不自行定義 metadata 應含哪些欄位（APP4 另有規定，屬其他 leaf 範圍）。

優先級：070-01 是整個 Preset Management 功能的入口訂 P1；070-02 的分頁上限影響版面訂 P1；指示器、metadata、關閉鍵為彈窗內的個別元素訂 P2。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 五筆分別驗彈窗開啟、每頁 bank 上限、Presets Shown 指示器、播放中 metadata、關閉的 X，驗證標的皆不同

assumption.note: ch18 calls the same popup both 'All Presets Pop up' (APP1) and 'Presets Pop Up' (APP2, APP10-13, APP17-18, and the page-30 screenshot caption). These TCs treat them as one container and use 037's own wording per clause. If RD-1 rules they are two different screens, the container anchoring of every ch18 parent must be revisited

APP1 lists a 'Presets Shown' indicator as part of the All Presets Pop-up, but in the page-30 screenshots that indicator appears on the Edit Presets Pop Up, not on the Presets Pop Up. If RD-1 confirms the screenshot, the object this TC verifies does not exist in this container and the TC must be rewritten against the Edit Presets Pop-up or withdrawn

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the All Presets Pop-up when the 'All Presets' button is pressed.

(All Presets button pressed on the Playing Tab)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot holds a stored station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Press the "All Presets" button on the Playing Tab
4. Read the content displayed over the Media screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The All Presets Pop-up is displayed over the Media screen
4. The All Presets Pop-up displays the stored presets and remains displayed over the Media screen
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display up to 3 preset banks per page in the All Presets Pop-up.

(More than 3 banks configured, in the All Presets Pop-up)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot holds a stored station
3. The Presets Shown indicator is set to more than 3 preset banks
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Press the "All Presets" button on the Playing Tab
4. Count the preset banks displayed on the first page of the All Presets Pop-up
5. Move to the next page of the All Presets Pop-up and count the preset banks displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The All Presets Pop-up is displayed over the Media screen
4. No more than 3 preset banks are displayed on the first page of the All Presets Pop-up
5. The remaining preset banks are displayed on the next page of the All Presets Pop-up, again no more than 3 per page
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the 'Presets Shown' indicator in the All Presets Pop-up.

(Indicator label in the All Presets Pop-up)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot holds a stored station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Press the "All Presets" button on the Playing Tab
4. Read the text displayed with the Presets Shown indicator in the All Presets Pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The All Presets Pop-up is displayed over the Media screen
4. The text displayed with the indicator in the All Presets Pop-up is "Presets Shown" and is not "Number of Presets Shown"
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display the currently playing metadata in the All Presets Pop-up.

(Metadata matches the Playing Tab, in the All Presets Pop-up)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot holds a stored station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab and record the metadata shown for the currently playing station
3. Press the "All Presets" button on the Playing Tab
4. Read the metadata displayed in the All Presets Pop-up
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed and the metadata of the currently playing station is recorded
3. The All Presets Pop-up is displayed over the Media screen
4. The All Presets Pop-up displays the metadata recorded in step 2
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall display a close ('X') button in the All Presets Pop-up.

(Close button present and functional, in the All Presets Pop-up)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. FM is the active source on the HU
2. At least one preset slot holds a stored station
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Playing" on the Tab Buttons to open the Playing Tab
3. Press the "All Presets" button on the Playing Tab
4. Read the controls displayed in the All Presets Pop-up
5. Press the "X" button in the All Presets Pop-up and read the content displayed on the HU
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and FM is the active source
2. The Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The All Presets Pop-up is displayed over the Media screen
4. An "X" close button is displayed in the All Presets Pop-up
5. The All Presets Pop-up is closed and the Playing Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
